column1: # ui field batch 5: ScoreDialog and GroupBar (23 fields).
# ScoreDialog extends OkDialog and only adds the score rows: three captions from the same set the
# main menu shows (Units Destroyed/Lost, Damage Inflicted/Sustained, Bases Captured/Lost) each with a
# player column at x=275 and an enemy column at x=360, and every value drawn twice - the black label
# offset by (+1,+1) is the shadow, the coloured one on top is the value (green -7168 for the
# destroyed/inflicted/captured half, red -65536 for the lost/sustained half):
# m/n/o (the three Images) stay unnamed: nothing in the constructor separates their roles.
# GroupBar: the eight squad slots are the parallel arrays slotButtons (e, data = slot index, x = 63 +
# i*60), slotRegions (f, the 32x32 unit icon), slotSelectionImages (g, the 58x58 highlight that
# selectGroup() shows only for the selected slot) and slotLabels (h, the Dungeon15Outline badge), with
# slotCounts (i, initialised to -1); slotButtonStyle (a) is the style every slot button is built with
# and selectedGroup (l) is what selectGroup() stores. toggleButton (c, data -1) with its toggleIcon
# (d) moves between y=0 (expanded) and y=8 (collapsed), which is exactly the expanded flag (k).
# unitCommander (j) is the callback target. Left unnamed: the three-entry ButtonStyle array (b), whose
# per-category split has no reader in the constructor.
